## Problem

What is wrong or missing, and for whom.

## Approach

What this change does and why this way. Name the alternatives you rejected.

## Look at this sceptically

The part of the diff most likely to be wrong: a physics constant, a membrane rule, a
prompt change, a concurrency edge between the dish thread and the mutagen.

## Checklist

- [ ] `scripts/task check` is green locally
- [ ] one unit of work, from its own worktree
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under `[Unreleased]` if a user would notice the change
